name: Hatsujou Switch ~Bishimai ga Saiminjutsu ni Ochita Saki~
original_name: 発情スイッチ ～美姉妹が催眠術に堕ちた先～
source: The main character, Matsuri Gen'ya, works as a counselor at St. Luitos Academy. After losing a power struggle at the hospital where he used to work, he was forced out and lost everything. Now, he uses hypnosis to manipulate female students under the guise of counseling. He makes them serve him, assaults them, and vents his frustrations during his boring days. One day, his colleague, a doctor named Sakura, lets slip that late professor Kirihara, whom Gen'ya respected as a mentor, left behind a special "inheritance". The principal is searching for it desperately, but its nature is unknown. Gen'ya decides to investigate by questioning Kirihara's daughters, Megumu and Saki, and extracting more information from Sakura. He's determined to use any means necessary to reclaim what he lost and will not let anyone stand in his way. The curtain rises on his tale of revenge.
translation: 主角祭源也，在圣路易斯学园担任辅导员。在他以前工作的医院的一场权力斗争中失败后，他被赶出了家门，失去了一切。现在，他打着心理咨询的幌子，用催眠术操纵女学生。他让他们为他服务，攻击他们，并在无聊的日子里发泄他的挫败感。有一天，他的同事、一位名叫佐仓的医生透露了源也尊为导师的已故桐原教授留下了一份特殊的“遗产”。校长拼命寻找，但其性质不明。源哉决定通过询问桐原的女儿惠和咲来进行调查，并从小樱那里获取更多信息。他决心使用一切必要的手段来夺回失去的东西，不会让任何人阻挡他的脚步。他的复仇故事就此拉开帷幕。
